basics.name: Vijay R Machingauth
basics.label: Lead - Post-Si and Silicon Readiness, Apple
basics.summary: Dynamic Technical Leader with experience building high-velocity, cross-geo teams to solve complex engineering challenges. Technical expertise and leadership experience across Power Management, Firmware design and validation, Pre/Post-Si Methodology, Pre/Post-si validation, architecture, design, Platform & system software simulation

work.summary: Lead the Post-Si and Si Readiness engineering program management team for SoCs that power various Apple products. Focus on Software and Firmware readiness for Silicon bring-up, E2E Post-Si execution management
highlights: Post-Si execution - debug WGs and TFs
Driving benchmarking/lessons learned to continously improve Silicon readiness
Lead efficiency opportunities using automation and adoption of Generative AI

work.summary: Led the client virtual platform (Simics, VP) and the Simulation Architecture teams - responsible for delivering virtual platforms with complete Firmware, driver, software stack for Intel's client products, R&D of advanced simulation capabilities. Hands-on role setting the technical direction & strategy, design, modeling, development, platform debug and deployment.
highlights: A first at Intel, the team delivered several critical platform power management flows on the Lunarlake and Pantherlake VP with full stack OS, FW and drivers. transforming foundational simulation and modeling capabilities like code generation focusing on efficiency and quality. Team driving software development practices and training

work.summary: Led the server Power Management IP/firmware validation and the Intel server manageability IP development teams - delivering power management and manageability IPs and FW for all Intel server products.
highlights: Delivered manageability IP and Power Management FW for Icelake Server, Snowridge, Icelake-D, Sapphire Rapids, Granite Rapids and Sierra Forest
Pre-si validation of critical flows like seamless patch load and rollback for power management firmware
Instrumental in driving significant improvements in IP and FW quality keeping pace with increasing complexity and scope gen-over-gen

work.summary: Senior Chief Engineer and Validation Architect responsible for validation strategy for Exynos mobile SoCs. Simulation, emulation, multi-IP & multi-processor validation strategies
highlights: Built IP and sub-system validation strategy for power management and memory. Lead the collaboration with industry EDA partners including Cadence, Synopsys and Mentor delivering verification strategies - SoC construction including Testbench creation - Magillem, Perspec, Jaspergold, IWB

work.summary: Led a team focused on Xeon power management post-silicon validation on Jaketown, Ivytown and Broadwell server. Driving test content development, execution and debug. Responsibilities include content and execution planning, failure debug for internal & customer reported issues.
highlights: Established Server power management Post-si expertise in the Bangalore and delivered several product launches, meeting and beating expectations

work.position: Technical Lead, Post-Silicon Debug and Debug tools
work.summary: Led a team developing post-silicon debug tools. These tools are used for the post-si system debug of Intel multi-core Xeon Microprocessors
highlights: Lead the team to deliver a SMI (interrupt) based Si-to-Model failure reproduction flow for the first time on a Server product - Ivytown

Built several innovative debug tools and solution that directly impacted TTM for several client and server products - 25% improvement in debug productivity on SandyBridge family of client/server products

work.summary: Validation tools - architectural/micro-architectural pre-si validation tools, developing simulation/emulation solutions.
highlights: Individually lead the development and support of simulation tools and models for Server development team in Bangalore
